_note: Copy to profile/profile.json (gitignored) and replace every <...> placeholder. Agents read this to fill application forms, pick resumes and draft outreach. Every fact here must also be true in factsheet.md. Leave a field as "" if you do not want it used.

identity._sensitive_note: Leave date_of_birth and gender empty unless a form requires them. Agents must ask you before filling optional demographic fields.

current_employment.employer_legal_name: <Legal entity, for forms that ask for employer name>
current_employment.title: <Your official title>
current_employment._note: If employed, agents follow docs/07-comp-and-discretion.md. Never reveal internals of this employer (customers, partners, ticket IDs, unreleased work).

compensation._rules: See docs/07-comp-and-discretion.md. current_ctc must be the truth that a background check would find. Expected is a range. Agents never invent numbers here.
compensation.current_ctc_numeric: <annual number in currency units, only for required numeric fields>
compensation.current_ctc_text: <how you say it in a text field, e.g. 'X lakhs per annum fixed'>
compensation.expected_ctc_high_band: <range to use when the posted band is clearly higher>

standard_titles_for_resume_headline: <the searched title you can honestly use>
targeting.years_of_experience: <e.g. 1 year 6 months of production work since Mon YYYY>
targeting.remote_preference: <e.g. on-site in my city, remote, or hybrid>
avoid_companies: <companies close to your current employer's network>

screening_answers._note: Short canonical answers. Longer ones live in profile/answers-bank.md.
screening_answers.work_from_office: <e.g. Yes, 5 days a week in City>
screening_answers.how_did_you_hear: <Company careers page / job board / LinkedIn post>
screening_answers.why_leaving_current_role: <positive, growth and scope focused, never negative about the employer>

resume_variant_map._note: Paths relative to the repo. rank.py picks <role>_<geo>, then <role>, then default. Roles: founding, ai, fullstack, backend, swe, fresher. Geo: india or global.

outreach._note: Used by jobhunt/outreach/draft_posts.py for first drafts. Agents still rewrite each draft per prompts/cold-outreach-drafter.md.

keywords: <words in a post that call for this angle>
pitch_angles.proof: <one or two sentences of proof, copied from factsheet.md>

outreach.default_angle: <key of the angle to use when nothing matches>
ps_lines: <a short true personal line, e.g. City-based and open to on-site>
